thread:
Morgan R: Heads-up — noticed an odd flow in eval-run when users hit rate limits and click the Retry button. The modal shows a plain 429 error text: `Rate limit exceeded. Please try again later.` Feels unfriendly and confusing for bulk reruns.
Devin L: Ugh. Is that the server response as-is or wrapped by the UI?
Morgan R: It's the server payload with no friendly copy, so the modal just surfaces it.
Sofia P: Repro steps?
Morgan R: Run an eval-run with 200 prompt cases, trigger automatic batching + rate limiter, then click Retry on the failed chunk. I saw the 429 in the modal. deploy-bot logged a bunch of `429 Too Many Requests` for that worker pool.
deploy-bot: Recorded 429 events: 2026-06-12T18:22:10Z - pool:dedicated-gpu-a - retry_allowed:false
Ashley M: UX notes: retry feels like a user intent to “try again now” — but backend says no. We should either:
- surface a scheduled retry (e.g., "We'll retry in 30s") or
- disable Retry and surface an ETA + explain why (backoff)
Karen S: Accessibility: modal content should announce the new state via aria-live and focus trap shouldn't move unexpectedly when the retry schedule changes.
Sofia P: Copy suggestion option A: "We're temporarily throttled. We'll retry this batch in 30s — no action needed." CTA: `Close` and link `View run details`.
Sofia P: Option B (if letting user queue immediate retry/backoff): "Retry now (may be queued)" + small helper text: "Requests may be delayed to prevent overloading the model pool. You can view scheduled retries in Run History." 
Devin L: Implementation constraints: backend returns `retry_after` header sometimes. We could surface that when present. If not present, default to exponential backoff estimate (30s -> 2m).
Ashley M: Microcopy nit: avoid technical words like "rate limit" in the modal, users don't need that vocabulary. Use friendly language: "temporarily busy" or "processing backlog".
Karen S: Keyboard: make sure Retry and Close are reachable with Enter/Space. If disabling Retry, focus should move to the primary close action; screen reader should read the updated helper text.
Morgan R: Also we should consider this edge case: bulk rerun where some chunks succeed and others are throttled — modal currently lists only the error rows, UI hides successful ones which makes context loss. Proposal: show counts: "12 succeeded, 3 queued for retry, 1 failed".
Sofia P: Proposed final modal layout (text block, counts, ETA, primary CTA):
```
[Header] Some batches are delayed
[Body] 12 processed, 3 will retry in ~30s, 1 failed permanently. We will retry automatically — no action needed. If you'd rather, queue an immediate retry (may be delayed).
[Primary CTA] Close
[Secondary CTA] Retry now (queued)
[Link] View run details
```
Devin L: Backend action items: expose `retry_after` in run status API + per-chunk state `scheduled_retry_at` so UI can show accurate ETAs.
Ashley M: Design action items: provide a small inline status pill in the run list: `retrying` with live countdown. Make sure color meets contrast (AA) and text scales.
Karen S: Accessibility action items: announce count changes via aria-live polite, expose `scheduled_retry_at` to AT users as "Retry scheduled in X seconds".
Morgan R: Product decision needed: do we auto-retry forever or cap retries? Current backend caps at 3 and marks failed. We should surface that cap in helper text: "We'll try up to 3 times." 
Sofia P: Final copy candidate for helper line: "We'll automatically retry this batch up to 3 times. Next attempt in ~30s." (short, clear)
Devin L: I'll open an infra ticket to add `scheduled_retry_at` + `retry_count` to the run status endpoint. @Karen S if you can list the ARIA requirements we'll make sure the API is discoverable.
Karen S: Will do. Also please add a flag for `aria-hidden` toggles for animated countdown so it's not noisy for screen reader users.
Ashley M: I'll mock the modal with both flows (auto retry + manual queue). Will drop frames in #design later today :paintbrush:
Morgan R: Great. Can we get a copy owner? @Sofia P can you own final microcopy? Also assign product decision on auto-retry cap to @Morgan R.
Sofia P: Happy to own copy.
Morgan R: Thanks all. Action items summary:
- Devin: API -> add scheduled_retry_at, retry_count, retry_after.
- Ashley: 2 mock variants + contrast check.
- Karen: ARIA spec & keyboard checks.
- Sofia: finalize microcopy + short variants.
- Morgan: make decision on retry cap translucence and confirm messaging.
Morgan R: tagging this for the next UX sync. If anyone sees unexpected behavior in other runs, drop repro in this thread. :white_check_mark:
